kankakee.songTitle: They Are Night Zombies!! They Are Neighbors!! They Have Come Back from the Dead!! Ahhhh!
stanza: Ring the bell and call or write us
Can you call the Captain Clitus?

kankakee.line: The train pulls out at Kankakee
stanza: Riding on the City of New Orleans
Fifteen cars and fifteen restless riders
Three conductors and twenty-five sacks of mail
The train pulls out at Kankakee
And rolls along past houses, farms and fields
Passing trains that have no name
And freight yards full of old black men
And the graveyards of the rusted automobiles
